newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Air Liberte suspends flights to Ivory Coast.
newsitem.headline: Air Liberte suspends flights to Ivory Coast.

text.p: Troubled price-cutting French charter company Air Liberte is to suspend its flights from France to Ivory Coast from Saturday, a company official said.
The official in Ivory Coast's commercial capital Abidjan told Reuters on Friday the move followed a decision to put the company under a court-supervised rescue plan.
"We have a six-month reprieve, until March 26 1997. After that date, we will know the fate of the company," he said.

Air Liberte set up in competition to struggling multinational carrier Air Afrique and Air France on the France-Abidjan route on January 18, offering huge reductions, particularly during the high season in August. It operated two return flights a week.
Portuguese carrier Air Portugal (TAP) offers similar reductions to Europe for passengers travelling via Lisbon.
